SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM payments WHERE status = '1' AND paid_at >= #{todayStart} AND is_delete = 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS income FROM payments WHERE status = '1' AND is_delete = 0 AND paid_at >= #{startDate} AND paid_at < #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS orderCount FROM orders WHERE created_at >= #{startDate} AND created_at < #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date
